fields.description: The form its route's material is delivered in (Material Stage: Delivered in Lifts As).
fields.label: Form

fields.description: First, second, third. Each lift is one wave off the consignment.
fields.label: Lift

fields.description: Weeks on the trough before this lift is taken. This is what differs between lifts: 8, 10 and 12 on Eryngium roots.
fields.label: Weeks on Trough

fields.description: Weeks rooting after it is lifted, before it is a plant the field can take. The same for every lift on most crops.
fields.label: Rooting

fields.description: Weeks on the trough plus rooting: how long after the consignment arrives this lift reaches the farm. Worked out rather than typed, so the two halves always add up to it.
fields.label: Delivered to Farm

fields.description: The share of the consignment this lift hands over. The shares of one form must come to 100%.
fields.label: Share
